description: Add generic toolboxLib.buildSkillBundle support code (lib/skill-bundle.nix) that assembles a Claude Code plugin dir from a pinned source, with fromClaudePlugin manifest filtering and a flattened passthru.skills view. First consumer: packages/mattpocock-skills at v1.1.0 (commit d574778, fromClaudePlugin=true). Consumable via home-manager programs.claude-code.plugins or .skills.
title: Package Claude skill bundles (buildSkillBundle + mattpocock-skills v1.1.0)
